text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that does not have LULC prediction as its primary focus. It uses an integrated assessment model (GCAM) to simulate energy-water-land system co-evolution under policy and climate scenarios. While it includes a land module and uses a downscaling tool (Demeter) to produce gridded land cover maps, the generation of these LULC projections is an intermediate step used as an input for analyzing system interactions, not the central research question. The paper's primary objective is to analyze the multi-sector dynamics and co-evolution of the entire energy-water-land system under carbon neutrality goals, not to develop or validate a national-scale LULC prediction model. The land system results are presented as aggregated land-use type areas and crop production, with the mapped outputs serving to identify spatial patterns of change, not as a core predictive exercise with dedicated accuracy metrics for LULC.)
